body:
## Result and scope

Status: **claimed_solved**, 2/5 substantive approaches. A complete candidate proves the source conjecture for finite central free hyperplane arrangements over characteristic-zero fields, in all ranks, including products and essentialization. The argument uses formality, rank-two relation-incidence graphs, and modular pruning. The independent AI audit returns PASS with no required mathematical correction. This is unrefereed; novelty is unverified, and no proof-assistant certificate or arbitrary-characteristic extension is claimed.

## Reviewable artifacts

- `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004609/PROOF.md`: unchanged frozen proof.
- `independent-audit/AUDIT.md`: full claim-by-claim adversarial review, not only its conclusion.
- Exact original author packet, independent checks, portable audit verifier, strict publication manifest, and final-layout verifier.

The earlier source manuscript arXiv:1707.07091 was withdrawn in January 2022. Its hand-enumeration and Proposition 4.8(a) defects remain explicit; those affected claims are not premises here. The withdrawal example is independently certified free and supersolvable.

## Verification

- Final-layout author checker and full independent audit replay passed with byte-identical outputs.
- Author diagnostics cover 11 fixtures through rank 6, 1,716 rational six-subsets, and 4,845 four-triple families.
- Separate audit diagnostics check symbolic rank arithmetic, a parameterized K4 relation core, modular attachments, a nonformal negative control, and an exact non-Fano Saito certificate.
- Strict publication verification rejects altered, missing, extra, duplicate, empty-inventory, unsafe-path, wrong-size, and wrong-hash controls.
- Only this problem's QUEUE.md status, turns, and previously blank findings cell change; every other queue byte and the existing header are preserved.

The packet contains original mathematical analysis and authorized verification metadata. It excludes scholarly PDFs/full text, dataset records/corpora, private sources, and private coordination material. No merge, release, DOI, or external outreach is requested.

Primary target: https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46883, printed pp. 283–286; withdrawal notice: https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.07091v4.
title: 30004609: characteristic-zero low-exponent supersolvability candidate
